citations.title: Delaware Division of Revenue, Doing Business in Delaware, Step 4: Learn About Gross Receipts Taxes
citations.quote: Delaware does not impose a state or local sales tax, but does impose a gross receipts tax on the seller of goods (tangible or otherwise) or provider of services in the state.
